Name: Handsome Alex
Author: ickybugs
Description:
[size=4]This mod provides an alternative look for Alex as well as provides consistency between his portrait and character models. Winter and beach versions are included. 

All changes made remain faithful to the original art style. 
[b]
[/b][size=4][b]HOW TO INSTALL:[/b][/size]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder.[/size]
